caption: The drawing depicts a single metal object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object appears to be a dark, somewhat weathered metal coffee pot with a wide base, a conical middle section, and a spout sticking out to the left near the top. The main color of the object is a dark grayish black, with areas of wear showing lighter, irregular patches of exposed metal or paint loss, especially on the lower part. A curved handle is attached to the midsection on the left side. The rim of the top opening and the spout have yellowish edges, and the pot's surfaces reflect light with subtle highlights and shading. Near the lower right of the object, the name “HARRY GROSSEN” is written in small capital letters. The rest of the background remains uniformly blank.
title: Petticoat Lamp
